id.description: Unique identifier for virtual extension range.

name.description: Name of the virtual extension range.

prefix.description: Prefix that the virtual extension range is associated with (Note: Standard mode must have leading '+' in prefix; BCD/Enhanced mode can have any valid prefix).

pattern.description: Pattern associated with the virtual extension range.

locationName.description: Location name if the virtual extension range is at the location level, empty if it is at the customer level.

locationId.description: Location ID if the virtual extension range is at the location level, empty if it is at customer level.

routeGroupId.description: Unique identifier of the route group.

trunkLocationName.description: Location of the trunk; required if `trunkName` is returned.

trunkLocationId.description: Location ID of the trunk; required if `trunkName` is returned.
